posts.t: Rasmus Dahlin and Jason Zucker are both good to go, Lindy Ruff says.

Rasmus Dahlin said he felt good today. He said knew he wouldn't be out long but hadn't expected to miss the rest of last week. Lindy Ruff said they'll see how he handles today, but he thought Dahlin looked good.
Sabres captain Rasmus Dahlin has returned to practice. Tyson Kozak is out there as well. No Justin Danforth today.
Rasmus Dahlin has rejoined his teammates this morning.
Rasmus Dahlin won’t join the Sabres in Montreal, Lindy Ruff said, but he’s progressing. Ruff is hoping Jiri Kulich can get to Montreal tonight and be an option for tomorrow.
